# DB — Storage

- Owner: `ticonnect-daemon`
- Stage: 3
- Layer: `daemon`
- Component graph: [generated/components/db.md](generated/components/db.md)

## Purpose

Own SQLite schema, migrations, repositories, transactions, integrity checks, and durable application data.

## Boundary

Daemon-only. Stores no configuration. Repositories expose typed operations. Network and media never write directly.

## Owned state

- ticonnect.db tables
- schema version

## Invariants

- `INV-CFG-1` — Configuration lives only in config.toml and SQLite stores no configuration. Test: crates/settings/src/tests.rs and crates/daemon/tests/storage.rs
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- transaction rollback on error
- WAL mode
- migration failure refuses startup
- no configuration in SQLite

## Open decisions

- key and database backup/export are out of scope for v1
- disk quota policy
- schema migration compatibility window
